nodes.label: Reply-through-the-shim fallback rule
nodes.rationale: All user-facing output must go through mcp__mux-shim__reply with no named destination — the broker knows which chat the session is talking to. Anything written only to the transcript or the tmux pane is invisible to the user. This file is a minimal safety net appended only when the mux-core plugin's SessionStart hook is unavailable for a spawn.
